item.title: Homeland - la Isla — Thu Sep 17, 6:00 PM — Academy Square Galleries
item.description: Studio Montclair (SMI) is honored to present “Homeland – la Isla,” a survey of work by Montclair artist José Camacho. The show will run from September 17 through November 27 at SMI’s Academy Square Gallery, 33 Plymouth Street, Montclair, NJ. An opening reception will be held on Thursday, September 17 from 6:00-8:00pm. “Homeland – la Isla” is comprised of 28 artworks that meditate on displacement and shifting landscapes; tracing the transitions from warm to cold, summer to winter. These works investigate the relationship between text and image and questions the gap between abstraction and figuration. According to the artist, they “explore the nature and physicality of ideas, materials, and a personal mythology.” The series also reflects the influence of a song entitled “Canción de Invierno” by Cuban composer Silvio Rodriquez, which helped Camacho connect to his Puerto Rican heritage after he emigrated to the United States in the 1980s. item.title: We the People — Fri Sep 18, 6:00 PM — Studio Montclair
item.description: Studio Montclair (SMI) is privileged to present “We the People,” a timely exploration of expansive visual interpretations of our country’s 250-year-old experiment in democracy. We the People will run from September 18 through October 23 at SMI’s Leach Gallery, 641 Bloomfield Avenue, Montclair, NJ. An opening reception will be held on Friday, September 18 from 6:00-8:00pm. The opening words of the US Constitution’s Preamble outlining the Constitution’s goals and justification, “We the People,” affirms that the US government serves its citizens and that the people are the ultimate source of the government’s power. This exhibition is comprised of work reflecting artistic perceptions of the trajectory and success (or lack thereof) of this 250-year-old experiment. It depicts Americans going about their lives amidst the tensions between the foundational ideals of “We the People” and its imperfect realities. item.description: Democracy doesn't protect itself—it depends on informed, engaged citizens. Join Civic and Voter Engagement, in collaboration with the African American Caucus, for a powerful screening of All In: The Fight for Democracy, the critically acclaimed documentary that examines the history and present-day reality of voter suppression in the United States. Featuring voting rights advocate Stacey Abrams, the film explores the historical barriers, systemic inequities, and ongoing challenges that continue to shape access to the ballot box and influence civic participation. More than a documentary, this screening is an opportunity to deepen your understanding of the democratic process, reflect on the importance of protecting voting rights, and engage in meaningful dialogue about one of the most fundamental rights in our democracy. item.title: New Jersey's 44th Annual Law School Day — Wed Oct 14, 1:00 PM — University Hall
item.description:
Are you thinking about applying to law school? Join us for our 44th Annual NJ Law School Day at Montclair State University! All NJ college students and alumni who are interested in applying to law school are welcome to attend!
